none: PAS NLM-00B628: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: IMP C CLAV[DIVS AVG]. Reverse description: Figure standing left, probably Pietas. Reverse inscription: probably PIETAS [AVG]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19mm, Weight: 1.96gms, die axis: 6
